about: Nine supplies of Persantin 100 oral immediate-release tablets appear with no other antiplatelet in the history.
All three short-acting dipyridamole supplies fall within 60 days of Disprin used only for occasional headache, and no other antiplatelet treatment is recorded.
Dipyridamole 100 mg tablets are supplied together with Cartia 100 mg (aspirin) every month, so dipyridamole is not the only antiplatelet and must not flag.
